# ferentin_workload_oauth_client (Resource)

An outbound OAuth client the platform uses when an `ferentin_mcp_server` has `upstream_auth_strategy = cc_federated`. The platform mints a token at the customer's IdP using these credentials and forwards it to the upstream MCP server.

Secret material is WriteOnly: `client_secret` and `private_key_jwt_private_key` flow through to the platform during apply but never enter Terraform state. Bump the companion `*_wo_version` integer to rotate.

## Import

Existing clients can be imported using `<tenant_id>/<id>` (or `<id>` alone when the provider's default `tenant_id` matches):

```
terraform import ferentin_workload_oauth_client.example <tenant_id>/<id>
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Outbound workload OAuth client — the credential the platform uses when an
# MCP server's upstream_auth_strategy = cc_federated. The platform mints a
# token at the customer's IdP and forwards it upstream.

# client_secret_basic example (Okta).
resource "ferentin_workload_oauth_client" "salesforce_cc" {
  name                    = "salesforce-prod-cc"
  description             = "Outbound creds for Salesforce MCP upstream"
  idp_type                = "okta"
  auth_method             = "client_secret_basic"
  audience_param_strategy = "audience_param"

  oauth_client_id = "0oa1abcd2efgh3ijkl"
  issuer          = "https://acme.okta.com"
  jwks_uri        = "https://acme.okta.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
  token_endpoint  = "https://acme.okta.com/oauth2/v1/token"

  # WriteOnly — value flows to the platform during apply, never enters state.
  # Bump client_secret_wo_version to rotate.
  client_secret            = var.salesforce_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1

  default_audience = "https://api.salesforce.com"
  default_scopes   = "api refresh_token"
}

# private_key_jwt example (Auth0).
resource "ferentin_workload_oauth_client" "snowflake_cc" {
  name                    = "snowflake-prod-cc"
  idp_type                = "auth0"
  auth_method             = "private_key_jwt"
  audience_param_strategy = "audience_param"

  oauth_client_id = "snowflake-mcp-client"
  issuer          = "https://acme.auth0.com"
  jwks_uri        = "https://acme.auth0.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
  token_endpoint  = "https://acme.auth0.com/oauth/token"

  private_key_jwt_alg                    = "RS256"
  private_key_jwt_kid                    = "kid-2026-q1"
  private_key_jwt_jwks_url               = "https://example.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
  private_key_jwt_private_key            = var.snowflake_private_key_pem
  private_key_jwt_private_key_wo_version = 1

  default_audience = "https://acme.snowflakecomputing.com"
}

variable "salesforce_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "snowflake_private_key_pem" {
  type        = string
  description = "PKCS#8 PEM private key for private_key_jwt auth"
  sensitive   = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `audience_param_strategy` (String) How the audience binds to the issued token. Allowed: `audience_param`, `pre_configured`, `resource_param`.
- `auth_method` (String) Client authentication method. Allowed: `client_secret_basic`, `client_secret_post`, `private_key_jwt`.
- `idp_type` (String) Identity-provider type. Allowed: `auth0`, `entra`, `generic_oidc`, `okta`.
- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer URL of the customer's IdP.
- `jwks_uri` (String) JWKS endpoint URL where the IdP publishes its signing keys.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for this client (e.g. `salesforce-prod-cc`).
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth `client_id` at the customer's IdP (not Ferentin's internal UUID — see `client_id_resource`).
- `token_endpoint` (String) OAuth token endpoint URL.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Plaintext client_secret. **WriteOnly** — flows through to the platform but never enters Terraform state. Only meaningful when `auth_method` is `client_secret_*`. Bump `client_secret_wo_version` to force a re-send on rotation.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Companion to write-only `client_secret`. Bump to rotate.
- `default_audience` (String) Default `audience` claim value. Overridable per MCP server.
- `default_resource` (String) Default RFC 8707 `resource` parameter. Overridable per MCP server.
- `default_scopes` (String) Default space-delimited scopes. Overridable per MCP server.
- `description` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the client is active for outbound mints. Default `true`.
- `private_key_jwt_alg` (String) JWT signature algorithm for `private_key_jwt`. Allowed: `ES256`, `PS256`, `RS256`.
- `private_key_jwt_jwks_url` (String) JWKS URL where the customer publishes the public key for this private_key_jwt config.
- `private_key_jwt_kid` (String) JWT `kid` header value.
- `private_key_jwt_private_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PEM-encoded private key for `private_key_jwt` auth. **WriteOnly**. Bump `private_key_jwt_private_key_wo_version` to rotate.
- `private_key_jwt_private_key_wo_version` (Number) Companion to write-only `private_key_jwt_private_key`. Bump to rotate.
- `sso_idp_id` (String) Optional FK to a `ferentin_identity_provider` for SSO inheritance.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID. Defaults to provider-level `tenant_id`.

### Read-Only

- `client_id_resource` (String) Server-generated UUID for this workload-client row. Distinct from `oauth_client_id` (the IdP-side string identifier).
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `direction` (String) Always `outbound` for cc_federated.
- `has_client_secret` (Boolean)
- `has_private_key_jwt_key` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource ID `<tenant_id>/<workload_client_uuid>`.
- `last_modified_by` (String)
- `managed_by` (String)
- `managed_by_client_id` (String)
- `managed_by_module` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version (platform #649).
